title: Actual compensated KL second-order limit for bounded density perturbations
source_anchor: Sinho Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling, August 20 2026, Exercise 1.7 / (1.E.1), printed p.43 / PDF p.55; Corollary 2.1.2, printed p.50 / PDF p.62. Issue #370.
target_statement: For any finite measure mu and a.e.-strongly-measurable real f with an a.e. uniform finite bound, the integral of klFun(1+epsilon*f), divided by epsilon^2, tends at punctured zero to half the integral of f^2. This is compensated entropy, not yet an identification with canonical probability KL or LSI-to-PI.
